grammar.point: Past simple vs. present perfect for relationships
grammar.point_ko: 관계를 말할 때 과거시제 vs 현재완료
grammar.explanation_en: Use past simple for a specific finished moment: 'I met her in 2015.' Use present perfect to describe a relationship that continues now: 'I have known her for ten years.' Both are common when talking about friendships and relationships.
grammar.explanation_ko: 특정한 끝난 순간에는 과거시제를 씁니다: 'I met her in 2015.'(2015년에 그녀를 만났어요). 지금까지 이어지는 관계에는 현재완료를 씁니다: 'I have known her for ten years.'(10년째 알고 지내요). 관계를 이야기할 때 두 시제 모두 자주 쓰입니다.

examples.en: I met my best friend in college.
examples.ko: 저는 대학교에서 가장 친한 친구를 만났어요.

examples.en: We have known each other for fifteen years.
I have kept in touch with her since graduation.
examples.ko: 저는 졸업 이후로 그녀와 연락을 유지해왔어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: How long have you known your best friend?

dialogue.line_ko: 중학교 때 만나서 10년 넘게 알고 지냈어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: That's wonderful. Do you keep in touch often?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, we call each other every week.

reading.title: A Lifelong Friendship
reading.text: I met Sujin when we were seven years old. We have been friends for over twenty years now. We had a few arguments over the years, but we always apologized and stayed close. We keep in touch every week, even though we live in different cities.
reading.text_ko: 저는 수진이를 일곱 살 때 만났어요. 우리는 지금 20년 넘게 친구예요. 그동안 몇 번 다투기도 했지만, 항상 사과하고 가깝게 지냈어요. 다른 도시에 살지만 매주 연락해요.
